title: headwater-method-import/1
description: What `headwater method import --json` prints: the method folder written and how the method's factors mapped to the flows of a release. Example: `headwater method import olca-toy --method "toy climate v1" --flow-list toy-1.0@37b242df3416 --json`.

name.description: The method's name in the source.

flow_list.description: The flow list the source's factors are written in.

release.description: The release whose flow list the factors are mapped to, `name@hash` with the full hash.

flow_list.description: The flow list of the method written.

flows.description: Elementary flows in the release's flow list.

factors.description: Factors read from the source, for every indicator.
Factors of this indicator in the source.

mapped.description: Flows of the release this indicator's factors map to.

copied.description: Flows of the release given a factor that covers their subcompartment, and none of their own.

not_in_flow_list.description: Factors whose flow is not in the release.

flows_without_factor.description: Elementary flows of the release with no factor for this indicator.

key.description: How the factor names its flow: the flow's id, or `name (compartment)`.

where.description: Where the factor is in the source, for example `CFs!A12`.

unmapped.description: Factors whose flow is not in the release's flow list, in the order of the source.

not_characterised.description: Elementary flows of the flow list with no factor for any indicator, sorted by id.

left_out.description: Categories of the source's method that were not read.

warnings.description: Rows of the flow mapping that no factor needed.
